origin.note: 535 Dollar Mill Rd SW — frame origin, (0,0)

frame.axes: x east, z south from origin

terrain.layout: TWO-LEVEL: heights_base_10m.bin = Float32 posts every 10 m (912 x 1302, row 0 = north edge); heights_near_2m.bin = Float32 values for the stored 2 m posts only (4556 x 6506 lattice), indexed by nearpost_mask.bin (1 bit per post, MSB-first) + nearpost_rows.bin (Uint64 LE row starts). Base posts are every 5th near post. Shipping form: the near file travels chunked as files.nearParts (ordered parts, each <= 8 MB — GitHub blob-API size limit); the loader fetches every part, concatenates them in order and verifies length + sha256 against the descriptor, reproducing the identical heights_near_2m.bin byte stream before sampling. Nothing else about the layout changes.
terrain.source: Stage 1-3 rebuild (USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar, Q2 ruling D grid) with the 2026-10-30 integration compose: pad-free grid (all inherited house pads OUT — Joshua 13:08/13:09) + bed-first water carve delta (channels only, lowering only) + cliff-535 walls regenerated on the pad-free grid (near mask extended +9,274 posts over the corridor). Water bodies keep Phase 3 levels; beds re-derived on the pad-free ground.

canopy.format: uint8 canopy cover % per 10 m cell; row 0 = north edge (bounds zMin), cols run east from bounds xMin; woodland where cover >= threshold_pct
canopy.height_rule_m: crown top = ground + (10 + 14 * cover/100) m (Oct 28 test-build rule, cover>=30 only); foliage bottom = ground + 2.44 m (8 ft tree-form rule), trunk below — drawn by index.html buildPkgCanopy in partial mode
canopy.source: USGS NLCD 2021 Tree Canopy Cover (CONUS) v2021-4 via MRLC GeoServer WCS (full-zone clip fetched 2026-10-30; native pixels ~18.5 x 22.2 m, nearest-sampled at cell centres — no invented smoothing)
canopy.clearings: NONE at this step — Joshua's 2026-10-30 ruling pulled the inherited house pads out of the terrain ("new means new"); pads and their house clearings (Oct 28 house-in-forest rule) are cut fresh at the buildings step. Open water only: cover zeroed inside the Phase 3 body outlines and the Chattahoochee stem corridor at its published width (Tatum rule)
